summary: Best scaffolding + best RL adapter additivity test
hypothesis: Combining the strongest inference scaffold (exp056's expand→coverage-select topology) with the best RL-trained adapter (grpo_kl_e1) should compound their individual gains — if the scaffold's lift is additive on top of RL, we'd expect a new quality ceiling above the SFT champion (0.440).
technique: The exp056 pipeline topology (expand 8 candidates on-device, then deterministically select top-7 by corpus-coverage score in Swift) is re-run with the grpo_kl_e1 RL adapter swapped in as the generative model, using greedy decoding, to test whether scaffold and adapter gains are complementary.
result: Scored 0.415 on the full-30 greedy gate (2 wins / 4 ties / 23 losses vs Sonnet), well below the SFT champion (exp056, 0.440). The scaffolding lift collapsed to +0.008 on the RL base vs +0.031 on the SFT base; nonRed was already 4 and coverage remained pinned at 3, confirming the RL adapter had already consumed the redundancy/coverage headroom the corpus-coverage select exploits — the two are substitutes, not complements. Discarded.
